beaker.definitionKo: 화학 실험을 할 때 사용하는 원통 모양의 유리그릇.
beaker.englishDescription: A cylindrical glass container used for chemical experiments.

catholicism.englishDescription: A religion that believes in the orthodox teachings of Christ.

chandelier.definitionKo: 천장에 매다는 화려한 모양의 전등이나 촛대.
chandelier.englishDescription: A fancy lamp or candlestick hung from the ceiling.

checker.definitionKo: 바둑판 모양의 무늬. 또는 그런 무늬가 있는 직물.
checker.englishDescription: A check pattern, or fabric with such a pattern.

competition.englishDescription: An event in which participants compete with their skills, intelligence, etc.

competition.definitionKo: 음악, 미술, 영화 제작 등의 실력을 겨루기 위해 여는 대회.
competition.englishDescription: An event held to measure the skills in music, art, filming, etc.

cycle.definitionKo: 상태가 바뀌었다가 다시 원래 상태로 되돌아올 때까지 과정.
cycle.englishDescription: The process in which something changes state and then returns to its original state.

design.definitionKo: 미술에서, 주로 연필 등을 사용해서 선으로 어떤 이미지를 그려 내는 기술. 또는 그런 작품.
design.englishDescription: In art, a technique for drawing an image with lines, mainly using a pencil or similar tool. Or such a work.

fuse.definitionKo: 전선이나 전기 기구에 정해진 것보다 센 전류가 흐르면 녹아서 끊어지며 전기를 차단하도록, 납과 주석의 합금이나 아연 등으로 만든 부품.
fuse.englishDescription: A part made of an alloy of lead and tin, or zinc, etc., which is designed to melt down and be cut off, disconnecting electricity, when current exceeding a fixed level flows through an electric cable or electric device.

gallery.englishDescription: A place specialized for exhibiting works of art.
A group of spectators at a golf game.

grill.englishDescription: A gridiron used for grilling meat or fish.

jogging.definitionKo: 건강을 유지하기 위해 알맞은 속도로 천천히 달리는 운동.
jogging.englishDescription: Exercise of running slowly at an appropriate speed to maintain health.

pester.englishDescription: To keep annoying someone very much.

pizza.definitionKo: 이탈리아에서 유래한 것으로 둥글고 납작한 밀가루 반죽 위에 토마토, 고기, 치즈 등을 얹어 구운 음식.
pizza.englishDescription: Food originating in Italy, made by baking a round, flat piece of dough topped with tomato, meat, cheese, etc.

ticket.englishDescription: A ticket such as an admission ticket, boarding pass, etc.

wiper.definitionKo: 비나 눈이 올 때 좌우로 움직이면서 자동차의 앞창 유리를 닦아 내는 장치.
wiper.englishDescription: A device that wipes the windshield by moving right and left when it rains or snows.

yoyo.definitionKo: 평평하고 둥근 것을 맞붙여서 짧은 축으로 연결하고 그 축에 실을 감은 다음, 실 끝을 손에 쥔 상태로 던졌다 당겼다 하는 장난감.
yoyo.englishDescription: A toy made of flat, circular plates connected to a short axle, played by winding a string around its axle, and spinning out and pulling back with the end of the string in one hand.

zigzag.definitionKo: 줄이나 걸음 등이 곧바르지 않고 한자 ‘之’ 자 모양의 상태.
zigzag.englishDescription: The state of a line, or someone's walking, going in a zigzag pattern instead of going straight.
